title: 0L - US Fish and Wildlife Service Bird Rescue
description: ORANGE BEACH, Ala. - U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service emergency responders rescue a northern gannet after a call from a resident of Orange Beach. U.S. Coast Guard video by Kerry Liles.
